components.source:
<script>
	/**
	 * Site header: the brand, the site's links (a link can hold a submenu) and one action, folding into a phone menu
	 * on a phone or wherever the row cannot hold them on one line, with an optional notice above. Sticky by default.
	 */
	import { onMount, tick, untrack } from 'svelte';
	import { afterNavigate, beforeNavigate } from '$app/navigation';
	import { page } from '$app/state';
	import { resolve } from '$app/paths';
	import SoImage from '../runtime/Image.svelte';
	import { fillParts, visitorText, visitorTextLang } from '../runtime/visitor-text.js';

	let {
		siteName = 'Studio',
		logo = null,
		links = [],
		ctaLabel = '',
		ctaLink = null,
		ctaStyle = 'primary',
		sticky = true,
		surface = 'background',
		showSiteName = true,
		logoSize = 'medium',
		notice = '',
		noticeLabel = '',
		noticeLink = null,
		so_text,
		so_o = undefined,
		so_id = undefined,
		class: className = ''
	} = $props();

	// The names of the menu and submenu buttons and of the navigation, in the language of the page.
	const text = visitorText();
	// The pieces of that wording in English on a page in another language are marked as English.
	const textLang = visitorTextLang();
	// The navigation's name, by an ID of its own that no author's anchor can take.
	const uid = $props.id();
	const navNameId = `so-nav-name:${uid}`;
	// The item ID of the link whose submenu is open; one at a time.
	let openSub = $state(null);
	let header = $state();
	// The phone menu is a native disclosure, and its open attribute is the menu's only state: the browser opens it
	// before the site's script runs (or when it never does), and the script keeps whatever the visitor chose.
	let menu = $state();
	let toggle = $state();
	let nav = $state();
	// A link marked to show under the link above joins the submenu of the nearest top-level link before it; one
	// with none before it stays at the top level.
	const groups = $derived.by(() => {
		const out = [];
		for (const item of Array.isArray(links) ? links : []) {
			if (item?.sub === true && out.length) out[out.length - 1].children.push(item);
			else out.push({ item, children: [] });
		}
		return out;
	});
	// Route IDs ("/about") do not depend on the base path the site is published under.
	const current = $derived(page.route.id);
	// The visible name, when there is one to show. Beside it the logo is decorative, so the brand is announced once.
	const name = $derived(typeof siteName === 'string' ? siteName.trim() : '');
	const nameShown = $derived(!!name && (showSiteName || !logo?.src));
	// A logo shown alone names the link by its own alternative text, which matches what it visibly says.
	const logoAlt = $derived(logo?.src && !logo.decorative && typeof logo.alt === 'string' ? logo.alt.trim() : '');
	// The logo shows at one of three heights, each with its widest, so a small copy of the picture is all it needs.
	const LOGO_BOXES = { small: [26, 130], medium: [34, 160], large: [46, 220] };
	const logoBox = $derived(typeof logoSize === 'string' && Object.hasOwn(LOGO_BOXES, logoSize) ? logoSize : 'medium');
	const logoSizes = $derived.by(() => {
		const [tall, wide] = LOGO_BOXES[logoBox];
		return logo?.width > 0 && logo?.height > 0 ? `${Math.min(wide, Math.ceil((tall * logo.width) / logo.height))}px` : `${wide}px`;
	});
	// The notice above the header, on every page that shows it. Its words show it, so clearing them removes it
	// (link and all); its link follows them once it has both a label and somewhere to go.
	const noticeText = $derived(typeof notice === 'string' ? notice.trim() : '');
	const noticeLinkText = $derived(noticeText && typeof noticeLabel === 'string' && noticeLink?.href ? noticeLabel.trim() : '');
	// A notice too long for one line is set as a short paragraph, its lines starting on one edge so the eye finds each.
	const noticeLong = $derived(noticeText.length + noticeLinkText.length > 110);
	// The last word carries the dot before the link, so when the link wraps the dot ends the line like punctuation. A
	// "word" too long to hold together (a phrase in a script without spaces) is left free to break.
	const noticeWords = $derived.by(() => {
		const at = noticeText.lastIndexOf(' ');
		const last = noticeText.slice(at + 1);
		return { head: noticeText.slice(0, at + 1), last, keep: last.length <= 24 };
	});

	/**
	 * Wider than a phone, the brand, the links and the action share one row while it holds them on one line, and fold
	 * into the menu (the compact header) when it cannot. Until the script has measured the row, and wherever it never
	 * runs, an estimate from their words decides, against the content width the row has at most; a full menu beside a
	 * long name starts compact, so it never shows wrapped. The script measures the row once it starts and again
	 * whenever its width or contents change (see measureFit).
	 */
	const crowded = $derived.by(() => {
		const words = (value) => (typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim().length : 0);
		let width = (nameShown ? words(name) * 12.5 : 0) + (logo?.src ? LOGO_BOXES[logoBox][1] + 10 : 0);
		if (groups.length) width += 24 + groups.reduce((sum, { item, children }) => sum + words(item?.label) * 8.5 + (children.length ? 30 : 0), 0) + (groups.length - 1) * 24;
		if (ctaLabel && ctaLink?.href) width += 24 + 32 + words(ctaLabel) * 8.8 + 37;
		return width > 1200;
	});
	// What the row measured as, once the script has measured it: null until then.
	let fits = $state(null);
	const compact = $derived(fits === null ? crowded : !fits);

	const hasMenu = $derived(groups.length > 0 || !!(ctaLabel && ctaLink?.href));

	/** Site-relative links go through resolve() so the site works under a sub-path. */
	const href = (link) => (link?.href?.startsWith('/') && !link.href.startsWith('//') ? resolve(link.href) : link?.href);
	/** A new tab's security tokens, then what the author said about the site the link goes to, each once. */
	const relOf = (link) => [...new Set([...(link?.newTab ? ['noopener', 'noreferrer'] : []), ...(typeof link?.rel === 'string' ? link.rel.split(/\s+/) : [])].filter(Boolean))].join(' ') || undefined;
	/** A link to one of the site's documents downloads it under its own file name. */
	const download = (link) => (link?.href?.startsWith('/') && typeof link.download === 'string' && link.download ? link.download : undefined);
	const isCurrent = (link) => !!link?.href?.startsWith('/') && !link.href.includes('#') && (link.href.length > 1 && link.href.endsWith('/') ? link.href.slice(0, -1) : link.href) === current;

	function closeMenu() {
		if (menu?.open) menu.open = false;
	}

	// Arriving on another page closes any open submenu.
	$effect(() => {
		void current;
		openSub = null;
	});

	/** The element ID of the submenu under the link with this item ID: by its place in the menu, unique and safe.
	 *  A section's anchor cannot hold a colon, so it never shares an ID with one. */
	const subId = (id) => `so-sub:${groups.findIndex((g) => g.item.id === id)}`;
	const subToggle = (id) => header?.querySelector(`[aria-controls="${subId(id)}"]`);
	/** The links in a submenu that go somewhere, in their order. */
	const subLinks = (id) => [...(header?.querySelectorAll(`[id="${subId(id)}"] a[href]`) ?? [])];

	/** Down Arrow on a submenu's button opens it and moves to its first link (the disclosure navigation pattern). */
	async function onSubToggleKeydown(event, id) {
		if (event.key !== 'ArrowDown') return;
		event.preventDefault();
		openSub = id;
		await tick();
		subLinks(id)[0]?.focus();
	}

	// A submenu panel that would cross the window's end edge opens back from its link's end edge instead (leftwards,
	// or rightwards on a right-to-left page). In the phone menu a submenu opens in place, so nothing is measured.
	$effect(() => {
		const id = openSub;
		const panel = id === null ? null : header?.querySelector(`[id="${subId(id)}"]`);
		if (!panel) return;
		panel.classList.remove('so-header__sub--end');
		const style = getComputedStyle(panel);
		if (style.position !== 'absolute') return;
		const box = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
		const width = header.ownerDocument.documentElement.clientWidth;
		if (style.direction === 'rtl' ? box.left < 0 : box.right > width) panel.classList.add('so-header__sub--end');
	});

	/** Choosing a link closes the menus, including links to the current page or an anchor on it. */
	function chose() {
		closeMenu();
		openSub = null;
	}

	/**
	 * Publishes how far down the window the header reaches while it stays at the top (0 when it scrolls away, is
	 * hidden or stays at the bottom) as --so-header-offset on the page root. The theme's [id] scroll margin adds
	 * to it, so jump links land below it. The computed style also counts a position set as a style: a sticky
	 * header stays in view at its top inset (only when it has one), a fixed one where it is, and either covers
	 * the top of the window when it sits nearer the top edge than the bottom.
	 *
	 * First it measures the notice above the brand row as --so-header-notice on the header: a sticky header is
	 * pinned that far above the window's top edge, so the notice scrolls away with the page however long it is,
	 * and the brand row, the menu button and the menu stay on screen.
	 */
	function publishOffset(el) {
		// Down to the notice's bottom edge, so the header's own padding and border above it scroll away too.
		const notice = el.querySelector('.so-header__notice');
		const noticeHeight = notice ? notice.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - el.getBoundingClientRect().top + 'px' : '';
		if (el.style.getPropertyValue('--so-header-notice') !== noticeHeight) {
			if (noticeHeight) el.style.setProperty('--so-header-notice', noticeHeight);
			else el.style.removeProperty('--so-header-notice');
		}
		const root = el.ownerDocument.documentElement;
		const style = getComputedStyle(el);
		const box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
		const top = parseFloat(style.top);
		const pinned = style.position === 'sticky' && Number.isFinite(top) ? top : style.position === 'fixed' ? box.top : NaN;
		const bottom = pinned + box.height;
		const reach = box.height > 0 && pinned < el.ownerDocument.defaultView.innerHeight - bottom ? Math.max(bottom, 0) : 0;
		const value = Math.ceil(reach) + 'px';
		if (root.style.getPropertyValue('--so-header-offset') !== value) root.style.setProperty('--so-header-offset', value);
	}

	// The height changes when the brand or the links wrap, at a breakpoint, and when the fonts load; an inset in
	// window units changes with the window. The sticky setting changes the position without the size, which the
	// observer would miss.
	$effect(() => {
		const el = header;
		if (!el) return;
		void sticky;
		const win = el.ownerDocument.defaultView;
		const update = () => publishOffset(el);
		// Chromium can resolve window units against the old size for a frame after the resize event.
		let frame = 0;
		const resized = () => {
			win.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
			frame = win.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
				update();
				frame = win.requestAnimationFrame(update);
			});
		};
		update();
		const observer = new ResizeObserver(update);
		observer.observe(el, { box: 'border-box' });
		win.addEventListener('resize', resized);
		// Focus leaving the notice's link pins the header again without changing its size.
		el.addEventListener('focusout', resized);
		return () => {
			observer.disconnect();
			el.removeEventListener('focusout', resized);
			win.removeEventListener('resize', resized);
			win.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
			el.ownerDocument.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--so-header-offset');
			el.style.removeProperty('--so-header-notice');
		};
	});

	/**
	 * Measures whether the row holds the brand, the links and the action on one line at the width it has. For a
	 * moment within one task (nothing is painted, and focus stays where it is) the header lays the row out
	 * as wide as its contents on one line, outside the compact header; the row's own width does not depend on its
	 * contents, so the answer does not depend on which arrangement shows, and the two never take turns. A phone
	 * always has the compact header, by the phone query.
	 */
	function measureFit(el) {
		const row = el.querySelector(':scope > .so-header__inner');
		const win = el.ownerDocument.defaultView;
		if (!row || win.matchMedia('(max-width: 767.98px)').matches) return;
		const available = row.getBoundingClientRect().width;
		const wasCompact = el.classList.contains('so-header--compact');
		el.classList.remove('so-header--compact');
		el.classList.add('so-header--measure');
		const needed = row.getBoundingClientRect().width;
		el.classList.remove('so-header--measure');
		if (wasCompact) el.classList.add('so-header--compact');
		const next = needed <= available - 1;
		// A change that would hide the control with focus waits, and so does one that would fold away the open menu:
		// checked again once the menu closes or focus moves on.
		const active = el.ownerDocument.activeElement;
		if (next !== !compact && (compact ? menu?.open || active === toggle : !!active && !!nav?.contains(active))) return;
		if (fits !== next) fits = next;
	}

	// Measured as the script starts, then (a frame later, once) whenever the row changes width, the brand changes
	// size (a logo loading), the row's contents change (an edited label, the colour scheme switch joining it), the
	// fonts load, a stylesheet changes or loads (the editor's preview restyling the links in place), the window
	// resizes (type sized to the window, while the row's width is held at its cap) or crosses a width where the
	// row's gaps change, or the menu or focus moves on.
	$effect(() => {
		const el = header;
		if (!el) return;
		const row = el.querySelector(':scope > .so-header__inner');
		if (!row) return;
		const doc = el.ownerDocument;
		const win = doc.defaultView;
		let frame = 0;
		const later = () => {
			win.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
			frame = win.requestAnimationFrame(() => measureFit(el));
		};
		// Not a dependency of the effect: the arrangement it settles on is what it reads.
		untrack(() => measureFit(el));
		const resized = new ResizeObserver(later);
		resized.observe(row);
		const brand = row.querySelector('.so-header__brand');
		if (brand) resized.observe(brand);
		const changed = new MutationObserver(later);
		changed.observe(row, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['src', 'hidden'] });
		doc.fonts?.addEventListener?.('loadingdone', later);
		// New type for the links folded away in the menu changes how wide the row needs to be, and nothing the row holds.
		const restyled = new MutationObserver(later);
		restyled.observe(doc.head, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
		const sheetLoaded = (event) => event.target?.localName === 'link' && later();
		doc.addEventListener('load', sheetLoaded, true);
		menu?.addEventListener('toggle', later);
		el.addEventListener('focusout', later);
		const widths = ['(max-width: 767.98px)', '(max-width: 1023.98px)'].map((query) => win.matchMedia(query));
		for (const query of widths) query.addEventListener('change', later);
		win.addEventListener('resize', later);
		return () => {
			menu?.removeEventListener('toggle', later);
			el.removeEventListener('focusout', later);
			for (const query of widths) query.removeEventListener('change', later);
			win.removeEventListener('resize', later);
			resized.disconnect();
			changed.disconnect();
			restyled.disconnect();
			doc.removeEventListener('load', sheetLoaded, true);
			doc.fonts?.removeEventListener?.('loadingdone', later);
			win.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
		};
	});

	/**
	 * A visitor who opens a link to an anchor is scrolled there by the browser before the height above is
	 * published, so a tall header can cover the target. Once that scroll (smooth by default) has come to rest, and
	 * again once the fonts have loaded (they can make the header taller), reveals the target if the header covers
	 * it, until the visitor moves on. Returns a function that stops it.
	 */
	function revealBookmark(el) {
		const doc = el.ownerDocument;
		const win = doc.defaultView;
		const hash = win.location.hash;
		let done = false;
		let frame = 0;
		const moves = ['pointerdown', 'wheel', 'touchstart', 'keydown'];
		const stop = () => {
			done = true;
			win.cancelAnimationFrame(frame);
			for (const type of moves) win.removeEventListener(type, stop, { capture: true });
		};
		for (const type of moves) win.addEventListener(type, stop, { capture: true, passive: true });
		const reveal = () => {
